description: This file defines a utility class `LocaleUtils` providing static methods for handling `Locale` objects related to language and merchant store currency, as well as extracting language information from HTTP requests.

classes.name: LocaleUtils
classes.description: Utility class for handling locale-related operations such as creating Locale objects based on language or merchant store data, and retrieving language from HTTP requests.

methods.name: getLocale
methods.description: Creates a Locale object based on the provided Language object.

methods.name: getLocale
methods.description: Creates a Locale object for currency format based on the merchant store's currency code, ignoring language.

methods.name: getRequestLanguage
methods.description: Retrieves the Language object from an HTTP request's session, falling back to the store’s default language if not found.
